company.name: Liquid Death
company.description: Liquid Death is a packaged-water brand founded in 2019 that has positioned itself as a pop-culture disruptive challenger through bold branding, viral marketing, and a sustainability-driven value proposition (E4, E3). The company presents itself as an alternative to traditional bottled water and targets younger, eco-conscious and pop-culture–oriented consumers (E6, E7, E8).

customers.primary_user: Millennials and Gen Z (health-conscious, environmentally aware, attracted to unconventional branding) (E6)
segments: Eco-conscious consumers seeking alternatives to plastic bottles (E8)

business_model.value_proposition: Packaged water differentiated through provocative, viral branding and a sustainability narrative positioning it as an alternative to incumbent bottled-water brands (E4, E3)
